settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Use the 'ab' monogram. Square, at least 64×64.

settings.content: Colours and fonts are set in assets/theme.css under BRAND TOKENS. Editing the variables there updates the whole store.

settings.label: Pre-order discount shown on the site
settings.info: Shows the price after the discount next to the regular price. This only changes what is displayed: the discount itself is the automatic discount in Shopify admin. Set to 0 when the offer ends.
